name: Keyuan Hu
headline: First-year M.S. student in Computer Science at the University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign
bio: I am a first-year M.S. student in Computer Science at the [University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign](https://cs.illinois.edu/). I currently work with [Professor Francis Y. Yan](https://fyy.cs.illinois.edu/) in the [Illinois Networked Systems and Artificial Intelligence Lab](https://github.com/illinois-nsai). My primary interests are reinforcement learning and computer systems.

Previously, I completed a dual-degree undergraduate program in Electronic and Computer Engineering at Shanghai Jiao Tong University and Mathematics (Honors) at the University of Michigan. At Michigan, I worked with [Professor Anhong Guo](https://guoanhong.com/) in the Human-AI Lab on human-computer interaction.
I enjoy learning about unfamiliar topics and exploring fields beyond my current research. This website is an organized record of my research, projects, and technical notes.
